# czc-v2026.10.21.9 (0.2.17.17)

Codex wire-parity round 2 — closes the remaining ClientHello/handshake differences found in the second audit against official `codex-rs` (rustls 0.23.46, tungstenite fork `4fffad3`, hyper 1.11).

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.21.8

- **TLS `status_request`(5)**: rustls emits `CertificateStatusRequest::build_ocsp()` unconditionally; our `rustls`/`rustls-h2` ClientHello profiles now include extension 5 inside the per-handshake randomized extension order. Previously absent — a JA3/JA4-detectable difference.
- **WS connect timeout 10s → 15s**: matches codex-rs `DEFAULT_WEBSOCKET_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`. Note: an explicit `gateway.openai_ws.dial_timeout_seconds` in `config.yaml` overrides the new default — remove or set it to `15` to adopt official behavior.
- **WS handshake header casing**: leftover (non-template) header names are now lowercased — Rust `http::HeaderMap` iterates lowercase-only; Go's canonical Title-Case keys differed on the wire.
- **HTTP lane header passthrough**: non-template headers are forwarded (lowercased) instead of silently dropped — reqwest sends the full HeaderMap.
- **h2 hardening**: HPACK `EncodeBlock` force-lowercases header names (spec requirement; prevents invalid uppercase names if a non-template header reaches the encoder).
- **PMD negotiation**: honors negotiated `client_max_window_bits` / `server_max_window_bits` instead of assuming a 15-bit window.

## Known intentional divergences (unchanged)

- Connection-failure retries: official `UnboundedConnectionRetries` retries forever; the gateway bounds this at 5 attempts then marks the account WS-disabled for ~15 min (client-visible wait would be unbounded otherwise).
- Upstream stream idle timeout 900s vs official 300s (the gateway tolerates longer silent streams).

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No migration. If `config.yaml` pins `gateway.openai_ws.dial_timeout_seconds`, update it to `15` (or remove) to match the official client.
